deviations.description: Two of this phase's four named 'touched files' (dispatch-worktree.sh, test-dispatch-worktree.sh) no longer exist
deviations.reason: Between Phase 4's commit (a8919f8fe, 2026-09-30 11:12) and this phase's execution, a separately-tracked task (the worktree-isolation-layer removal task, now completed) deleted dispatch-worktree.sh and both of its test files (test-dispatch-worktree.sh, test-dispatch-isolation-fixture.sh) wholesale -- source store and deployed tree alike -- removing the whole per-dispatch worktree-provisioning layer. Confirmed via `git log --oneline -1 -- agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/dispatch-worktree.sh` (last touch: a deletion commit) and via direct filesystem absence in both agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/ and .claude/scripts/. Consequence: the false-green mechanism this task fixed (a cp -al hardlink clone of .lake/ sharing build-guard.* state across trees) is now structurally unreachable -- `grep -rl 'cp -al' agent-system/` matches only lake-build-guard.sh itself, its own test, and the batch-orchestration-guardrails.md decision record; no production clone site remains anywhere in the codebase. Phase 1's T14/T15 and Phase 2's fix lived entirely inside the now-deleted files and cannot be re-verified. Phase 3's Test C (test-lake-build-guard.sh) and Phase 4's lake-build-guard.sh header convention both survived intact and are confirmed still green below -- they remain the standing guard against any future cp -al-cloning consumer.

deviations.description: Phase 5's verification criteria state deploy-headless.sh, verify-deploy.sh, and run-all.sh all exit 0
deviations.reason: deploy-headless.sh: the copy/sync step lands cleanly; its own trailing fast-verify wrapper reports RESULT=landed_verify_red on 1 pre-existing, unrelated finding (Gate 20: skills/skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md exceeds its 20000 B context-budget ceiling at 20930 B -- already tracked by a separate, concurrently-dispatched sibling task this same cycle per this dispatch's Territory Notes). verify-deploy.sh (run in full, no --skip-slow): FAIL -- 2 of 34 checks failed -- Gate 8 (run-all.sh in deployed mode, same NEW failure as below) and Gate 20 (the same SKILL.md budget finding). run-all.sh (source-store mode): 102 passed, 4 failed (3 expected, 1 NEW), 0 skipped, 106 total. The 3 expected failures (test-gate-out-repair-reporting.sh, test-lint-json-channel-discipline.sh, test-run-all-parallel.sh) match agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/tests/known-failures.txt exactly. The 1 NEW failure (test-typst-element-lint.sh, case-h2 unexpectedly emitting a [WARN]) is explicitly documented in that same manifest's own header comment as traced to an uncommitted, concurrently in-flight working-tree change to agent-system/extensions/typst/scripts/typst-element-lint.sh at seed time -- confirmed still the case via `git status --short` showing exactly that file modified, and never touched by this task. None of the 4 run-all.sh failures, nor the Gate 20 budget finding, reference dispatch-worktree.sh or lake-build-guard.sh in any way. test-lake-build-guard.sh -- the one suite still live in this task's own file_scope -- passes 48/48 including Test C, both standalone and inside run-all.sh. The suite count moved 105->106 between this task's Phase 2 baseline and now, expected given the other task's removal of 2 suites (test-dispatch-worktree.sh, test-dispatch-isolation-fixture.sh) netted against other sibling tasks' additions in the interim.
